scenes.text: A short walkthrough of the real app. All tickets and people shown are fictional.
Start with progress: 53 points completed, 41 remaining, and scope that changed.
Risk signals explain what deserves a conversation with the team.
Filter to blocked work to find the tickets behind the warning.
Import a sprint CSV locally. This example file contains only synthetic tickets.
A CSV has no scope history. Unavailable means unknown, rather than zero changes.
Correct unfamiliar statuses. Here, Discovery should count as In Progress.
Check the result: the imported ticket now appears as In Progress.
Reset to the demo. Use the signals to guide discussion, not to predict a finish date.
